G31 written in notes-D3.md before any P21 line was read: P21 is shown when a concept shows the room's members disputing, or stating the limits of, who may commit the room to an agreement with other rooms: one member's or the room's agreement not binding every placer, or the room unable to stop everyone placing in its name; a treaty, deal or alliance denied as speaking for them, or refused when others made it; a member disclaiming that their word commits the room; members asking another group for a leader or someone to deal with. A visitor's request or disclaimer shows it for the visitor's room, and in this room only where its members answer that no one can commit the room or dispute who can. Not shown by undisputed terms (P08) or coalitions (P17), an undisputed envoy (R02) or decided negotiator (C01), attacks suffered from an ally's placers, or restraint asked of the room's attackers, unless the limit of who binds is said. Not universal: G2 and G3 rule absent lines; G9 rules restrict lines, and what prompts the dispute is A21's order, not P21's claim; G4a names P08, P17, A04, A14, A19, P07, P09, P05, P18, C01, K01 and P20. Once P21's status is ruled, the carried lines of P21's form are read again under G4a
